messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT P1: web-api 503s spiking after deploy (deploy-id: r2026-03-12T22:40). Alert: 503 rate + error 'failed to decrypt secret'. Paging #incidents and #eng-oncall.

priya_m: I pushed the deploy and a post-deploy Vault rotation hook ran as part of the job. Seeing the Datadog error stream now. rolling back if needed.

alex_r: oncall taking. @priya_m can you paste the post-deploy hook logs and the exact Vault command it ran? also any recent policy changes?

priya_m: logs: 
```
2026-03-12T22:41:03Z post-deploy: invoking vault-rotate-hook
2026-03-12T22:41:07Z vault: policy apply deploy-runner -> rotate-only
2026-03-12T22:41:08Z vault: attach policy success
2026-03-12T22:41:12Z web-api: ERROR failed to decrypt secret: permission denied
```

linda_support: we have 3 enterprise customers on dedicated clusters reporting errors (tickets coming in). reported start ~22:42 UTC.

alex_r: ok that's consistent. sounds like the post-deploy hook replaced the deploy-runner policy with a restrictive 'rotate-only' policy, which revoked read access to secret/data/web-api. @daniel_s can you confirm from Vault audit logs?

daniel_s: checking Vault now. audit shows a write at 2026-03-12T22:41:06 by ci-runner-01 (deploy job) executed `sys/policies/acl/deploy-runner` with payload that set rules to only allow `rotate` paths. that is a bad template substitution in the hook.

daniel_s: grep from vault audit: `caller=ci-runner-01 path=sys/policies/acl/deploy-runner op=update result=ok` then subsequent `token lookup` for web-api service fails with 403.

alex_r: impact: web-api unable to read secrets -> token decryption fails -> 503 for requests that need model keys. mitigation options: 1) toggle feature-flag to bypass Vault (ff: use_vault_agent -> false), 2) rollback deploy, 3) restore correct policy immediately.

eva_prod: product impact: realtime generation endpoints for Dedicated customers are failing; public hosted customers not severely affected. looks like ~15-25% of requests 503 in last 10m. several active enterprise tickets.

priya_m: I can revert the hook change and reapply the correct policy, but that's risky in-hit. I'll prepare a rollback command now.

alex_r: do quick kill-switch first to stop further degradation: toggle ff to fallback static secrets from k8s env for affected pods. priya, can you flip `use_vault_agent` to false for prod? that should let pods use mounted env secret copies while we fix Vault policy.

priya_m: running: `ff-toggle prod use_vault_agent false --reason \"incident - vault policy rotation misfire\"`

oncall-bot: Action logged: feature-flag change by priya_m at 2026-03-12T22:47:10.

priya_m: flipping done. immediate check: health endpoints still returning 503 for some replicas. looks like pods need restart to pick up env override.

alex_r: do a rolling restart of web-api replicas in prod (one at a time) to pick up fallback env. command: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/web-api -n prod`

priya_m: started restart.

linda_support: customers reporting partial recovery — one enterprise confirmed traffic is back for their nodes. more reports coming in.

daniel_s: while restarts complete, I'm preparing the correct ACL payload to reapply. policy content has required `path \"secret/data/web-api/*\" { capabilities = [\"read\",\"list\"] }`. current policy missing that.

alex_r: timeline check: incident start 22:42, feature-flag flip 22:47, rolling restarts 22:48-22:55, partial recovery 22:53. we should still roll back the deploy for full safe state if policy reapply is nontrivial. priya, can you still run `kubectl rollout undo` if needed?

priya_m: I can. hoping restarts + ff will be enough. rollback on standby.

oncall-bot: PagerDuty: acknowledged by alex_r.

priya_m: restarts finishing, traffic and 200s are trending back up. Datadog 503 spike reducing.

eva_prod: rough metrics: 503s peaked 17% of requests, affected window ~00:35 minutes from first 503 to full recovery for most customers. 3 enterprise customers impacted with degraded experience; CS informed.

daniel_s: I re-applied corrected policy at 22:58 manually: `vault policy write deploy-runner deploy-runner.hcl` (policy includes read/list for web-api). post-apply token checks show success.

alex_r: good. can we confirm there are no lingering deploy hooks that will re-trigger the bad template?

priya_m: investigating the CI hook: template bug in `deploy-tools` repo where an if/else can produce an empty rules block when a variable is unset. I pushed a hotfix to the hook and pinned deploy-tools commit in the release job to the previous stable SHA until we run a full fix.

linda_support: CS update sent: affected customers were notified with ETA and that we mitigated — ticket numbers attached to incident.

alex_r: summary for incident record: root cause - post-deploy hook template bug caused wrong Vault ACL to be applied to deploy-runner role, revoking secret read perms. mitigations - feature-flag toggle to fallback env, rolling restart to pick up fallback, manual policy restore, hook fix and CI pin. impact - ~17% 503s, 3 enterprise customers affected, incident duration ~36m.

eva_prod: assigning RCA owner to daniel_s for follow-up and postmortem. I'll coordinate customer follow-ups with Linda.

alex_r: incident declared mitigated. moving to postmortem. handoff: I'm handing off pager/monitoring watch to daniel_s for next 2 hours.

daniel_s: ack, will watch audit logs and queue a safe reapply test in staging.

oncall-bot: Incident P1 mitigated at 2026-03-12T22:58. Incident page: https://incidents.redwood.internal/1767777000

priya_m: filing follow-up PR to add a safe-guard check in the deploy hook: refuse to write policies with empty rules and add a CI integration test.

alex_r: thanks all. postmortem assigned; please add any additional notes to the incident doc. :white_check_mark:
